meta.title: Izard County — the money trail
meta.note: This is Izard County's 2026 budget book, as sent to the state. Amounts are the 2026 column on each office's budget page. On a few pages the line items do not add up to the printed total; we show the printed total and say so. The book has no appropriation ordinance, and its summaries label the 2026 column “Requested,” so the quorum court’s final amounts may differ.
